name: Fox
description: Niagara Fox is a protocol used natively within the Niagara Framework. It handles real-time communication between Niagara stations (JACE controllers, Supervisors), system engineering software (Niagara Workbench), and secure Niagara Cloud Suite services.Because Fox is a proprietary application-level protocol, it does not act as a field device protocol (like BACnet or Modbus); rather, it operates strictly at the automation and management tier.
